entities.name: Location area identification
entities.description: An information element that may be included to assign a new location area identification to a UE during a combined TA/LA update.

entities.name: Combined TA/LA update
entities.description: A procedure where tracking area and location area are updated simultaneously.

entities.name: May be included
entities.description: Condition indicating the location area identification IE is optional in the message.

relations.description: The combined TA/LA update procedure may include the location area identification IE.
The inclusion of the location area identification IE is guarded by an optional condition.
